**Observations on test image:** Green mango leaf with scattered white/pale circular powdery patches distributed across the entire surface. No dark lesions, no tissue death, no galls.

**Comparison:**
- **Powdery_Mildew**: Reference shows identical white circular powdery spots on green leaves — exact match to the test image pattern.
- **Sooty_Mould**: Shows dark/black coating on leaves — clearly different from the white patches in the test image.
- **Anthracnose**: Shows brown margin lesions and tissue necrosis — not matching.

The white powdery circular patches on an otherwise healthy green leaf are the hallmark of Powdery Mildew.
